studio.noCourses: You don’t have any courses yet.

banner.draft: Draft: this course isn’t visible yet. Complete it, then send it for review.
banner.in_review: In review: the Yekkola team is checking your course. It can’t be edited meanwhile.
banner.rejected: Your latest version was declined. Fix it, then send it for review again.
banner.live: Live: students see this version. To change it, start a new draft.

banner.live_in_review: Live, changes in review: students keep the current version until then.
banner.unpublished: Offline: no new enrolments; enrolled students keep their access.
banner.archived: Archived: only visible to students already enrolled.

studio.noDraftBody: The live version isn’t edited directly. Start a draft: it copies the current course, and your changes go live after review.
studio.startDraftHint: Copies the live version so you can change it; students see nothing until it is approved.
studio.readOnly: This version is in review and can’t be edited. Withdraw it from review to make changes.
studio.detailsIntro: What students read before enrolling. Reviewed before publication.
studio.descriptionHint: Who the course is for, what it covers, how it is organised.
studio.outcomesHint: 3 to 8 short sentences: “By the end, you will know…”.
studio.requirementsHint: Optional: what students need to know or have before starting.
studio.changelogHint: Optional: what changes compared with the live version (for the reviewer).
studio.coverHint: 16:9, at least 1280 × 720 pixels (JPEG, PNG or WebP, 5 MB max).
studio.settingsIntro: Helps students find the course. Applied at once, without review.
studio.pricingIntro: Free or paid, in one of the available currencies.

priceModeHints.free: One-tap enrolment: great for building an audience.

studio.priceInvalid: Enter an amount, for example 15 or 15.50.
studio.pricingGoingForward: A price change applies at once, to new orders only: enrolled students keep their access.
studio.curriculumIntro: Organise the course in sections and lessons. Drag the handles to reorder; every change is saved right away.
studio.noSectionsHint: Add a first section, then its lessons.

studio.previewHint: Visible without enrolling, to win students over (at most {max} per course).

teach.title: Share what you know with all of Congo
teach.subtitle: Create courses with video, audio, documents and quizzes. Students follow you from any province, even on little data.

reach.title: Students everywhere
reach.body: Your courses can be followed from every province, on a phone or a computer.

earn.title: You set your prices
earn.body: Free or paid courses; students pay with mobile money and you are paid the same way.

protect.title: Your content protected
protect.body: Encrypted videos, documents stamped with each student’s name: your work stays yours.

trust.title: Chosen teachers
trust.body: Every professor and every course is reviewed, so students know they can trust you.

apply.title: Apply
apply.body: Tell us your subjects, experience and a sample lesson. About 10 minutes.

review.title: We review
review.body: The Yekkola team looks at every application and answers, or asks for more information.

create.title: Create your courses
create.body: The studio guides you: sections, lessons, quizzes, prices.

publish.title: Publish
publish.body: After review, your course goes live and students can enrol.

requirements.expertise: Real command of the subjects you teach.
requirements.experience: Teaching experience (school, university, private lessons, professional training).
requirements.material: Something to record with: a phone is enough to start.
requirements.phone: A Yekkola account (phone number) and a mobile money account to be paid.

teach.finalBody: Applying is free and works from your phone.

hints.motivation: A few sentences: what you want to pass on, and to whom.

reviews.title: Course reviews
reviews.intro: Every version is reviewed before students can see it.
reviews.approveHint: The course is published and students can see it.
reviews.approveUpdateHint: This version replaces the live one; students see the changes at once.
reviews.approvePaused: The professor is suspended: approval is paused, rejecting is still possible.
reviews.rejectHint: The professor gets your notes and can fix the course and send it again.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.intro: Student requests and refund payouts. The money goes back to the number that paid.
refunds.approveHint: Access to the course is removed and the money goes back to the number that paid.
refunds.rejectHint: The student keeps access. They see the note.
refunds.retryHint: The last attempt is checked with the operator first.

payouts.title: Professor payouts
payouts.intro: Payout batches per currency. A batch is built on the schedule; you can also build one now.
payouts.approveHint: Each payout is sent to the operator. Failed ones stay available for the next batch.
payouts.draftHint: Leave out any payout that shouldn't be paid first.
payouts.excludeHint: The money stays available for a later batch.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.intro: Every account with its totals, and every posting. Nothing is edited here: a correction is an adjustment.
ledger.balanceHint: Balance = debits − credits. A negative balance on a professor account is what the platform owes them.

adjust.title: Adjust {name}'s balance
adjust.hint: A balanced posting against platform revenue. It can't be edited afterwards.

directions.credit: Add to the balance (the platform owes more)

adjust.label: Label
adjust.labelHint: Shown to the professor on their statement.
adjust.reasonHint: Internal: kept in the audit log.

orders.title: Orders
orders.intro: Orders and payments. Find an order by number or phone.
orders.checks: {count, plural, =0 {Never checked} one {# check} other {# checks}}

users.title: Accounts
users.intro: Students, professors and staff. Search by phone or name.
users.reactivateHint: The account can sign in and follow its courses again.
users.suspendHint: The account is signed out everywhere. It can sign in to read why, but can't follow courses.
users.banHint: The account is signed out everywhere and can't sign in again. Its reviews are hidden.
users.signOutHint: Every session and app will have to sign in again (e.g. a lost phone).
users.removeDeviceHint: It is signed out and its downloads stop at its next sync.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Platform settings. They apply going forward only: past orders, prices and earnings don't change. Every change is logged.

commerce.default_revenue_share_hint: The default; can be changed per professor and per course. Fixed on each sale.
commerce.enabled_rails_hint: Untick an operator to pause it during an outage.
commerce.refund_max_progress_pct: Most progress allowed for a refund (%)

payouts.payout_method_change_hold_hours: Hold after a payout number change (hours)
payouts.platform_pays_disbursement_fees: The platform pays the operator's fees

learning.certificate_requires_quizzes_passed: All quizzes passed for the certificate

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every staff action and settings change: who, what, on what, the details and the IP address. Nothing here can be changed.

staff.title: Staff
staff.intro: Who has back-office access, with their role and any added permissions (e.g. finance).
staff.inviteHint: The account is created if it doesn't exist; they sign in with an SMS code.
staff.changeHint: The role gives a set of permissions; you can add more.
staff.extraHint: On top of the role's (e.g. the finance permissions).
staff.removeHint: The account stays (as a student) but loses the back office and is signed out everywhere.

courses.title: Courses
courses.intro: Every course. Unpublishing takes a course off the catalogue (enrolled students keep access); a takedown closes it to everyone, enrolled students included.

hints.unpublish: The course leaves the catalogue. Students already enrolled keep their access.
hints.republish: The course comes back to the catalogue.
hints.take_down: The course leaves the catalogue and nobody can follow it any more, enrolled students included. Downloads are removed at the next sync.
hints.restore: The course is published again and open to enrolled students.

courses.featuredHint: Shown in this order on the home page.
